identity: Separate experimental condition from A03, 400 mm pipe series, nominal 400 g C-4, PIPE99

source.pdf: ../../references/experiments/mendeley-zv7y78twd9-v2/raw/Kristoffersen et al - 2024 SW - Semi-confined blast loading.pdf

geometry.origin: centre of the spherical charge at mid-length and on the pipe axis

condition.mounting: Kulite HKS-375 (M), flush with the interior wall, sampled at 0.5 MHz

comparison.prediction: Maximum native wall static absolute pressure minus 101300 Pa, evaluated only inside the fixed solver-time window. A maximum at either boundary invalidates peak comparison for that gauge.
comparison.simulation_time_zero: source ignition at the sphere centre
comparison.published_time_alignment: Figure 15 shifts the experimental traces to match the Pi02 front. Peak values are baseline-corrected pressure amplitudes. No arrival-time comparison, time shift, or waveform error is applied.
comparison.window_basis: Figure 15 shows all six experimental and three EPX maxima within its first 4 ms. Section 3.2.2 reports late drift beyond approximately 5 ms. The time window is fixed before any independent solve.
comparison.completion: Normal healthy integration and original pressure traces covering 0 to 4 ms at all three prebound gauges. Complete accuracy groups additionally require a resolved positive finite peak at each gauge. Keep task completion, accuracy availability and model-match approval separate.
comparison.secondary_figures_only: Figure 15 traces and Table 4 impulse values are retained as source evidence. They are outside this fixed peak-only evaluation.
